rule_note: Thun: sow on the day type that matches the part of the plant you want. The ascending/descending Moon is not used for sowing here.

activity: Pot up, repot, divide or take cuttings
rule_note: Descending Moon = "planting time" (sap and growth said to be drawn toward the roots). Used for transplanting, repotting, dividing and rooting cuttings.
Ascending Moon = "harvest time" (sap said to rise; harvest kept to store better). Harvest leaves on Leaf days, flowers on Flower days, fruit/seed on Fruit days, roots on Root days.
